metadata.description: Nuno Amorim's Claude Code plugins. Each plugin lives in its own repository; this repo is the catalog.

plugins.name: agile-ledger
plugins.description: Manage a Scrum backlog of Epics and User Stories, plan and run sprints, drive a board, track velocity, cut Major.Minor releases, and keep GitHub branches/commits/PRs traceable to stories — all from slash commands, in a ledger repo that keeps your code repos clean.

plugins.name: agile-ledger-pro
plugins.description: The next generation of Agile-Ledger: the same plain-Markdown Scrum/Kanban ledger and commands, plus a local dashboard, insights and release notes. Reads an existing Agile-Ledger 2.0 ledger with nothing to migrate.

plugins.name: cartographer
plugins.description: Generate stakeholder documentation from a project's repositories — what each product does and how it fits together, as black-and-white Markdown + PDF.

plugins.name: idea-ledger
plugins.description: Capture ideas, track how each one evolves (v1, v2, v3…), and version what ships — in two plain-Markdown files (Backlog.md + VersionControl.md). The lightweight predecessor of Agile-Ledger.

plugins.name: fortify
plugins.description: Assess how easily your product can be reverse engineered, cracked, scraped or cloned, then get a tailored protection plan in plain language, and apply it.
